def G(x,g):
 n=x.bit_length()+3;b=[(x>>i)&1 for i in range(n)];out=0
 for i in range(n):
  v=b[i]^int((i>0 and b[i-1])or(i>1 and b[i-2]))
  if i==0 and g!='t':v^=1
  if i==1 and g=='p' and x%2==0:v^=1
  out|=v<<i
 return out
def evaluate(w):
 x=1
 for g in w:x=G(x,g)
 return x
def H(w):
 x=1;out=[]
 for g in w:x=G(x,g);out.append('tupp'[x%4])
 return ''.join(out)
def count(w):
 x=1;c=[0]*48
 for g in w:c[3*(x%16)+'tup'.index(g)]+=1;x=G(x,g)
 return c
def difference(w):
 hw=w
 for _ in range(6):hw=H(hw)
 return [a-b for a,b in zip(count(hw),count(w))],hw

 left=s['left_word'];right=s['right_word']
 assert left[-1]==s['generator'] and evaluate(left[:-1])%65536==s['q']
 assert evaluate(left)%65536==evaluate(right)%65536==s['y']
 dl,hl=difference(left);dr,hr=difference(right);row=[a-b for a,b in zip(dl,dr)]

def det_bareiss(m):
 a=[row[:]for row in m];prev=1;sign=1;n=len(a)
 for k in range(n-1):
  if a[k][k]==0:
   j=next(j for j in range(k+1,n)if a[j][k]);a[k],a[j]=a[j],a[k];sign=-sign
  pivot=a[k][k]
  for i in range(k+1,n):
   for j in range(k+1,n):
    numerator=a[i][j]*pivot-a[i][k]*a[k][j];assert numerator%prev==0;a[i][j]=numerator//prev
   a[i][k]=0
  prev=pivot
 return sign*a[-1][-1]
